# Pratik Renuse

> Growth marketing leader, 3x TEDx speaker and startup mentor based in Pune, India. Built marketing from zero at Bueno, Infento ($848K Kickstarter, the most funded STEM project of 2018) and VU. Mentor at Techstars, EBRD Star Venture and Seedstars. Visiting professor at Masters' Union and Tetr College of Business. Runs hands-on AI sessions for marketers, including the sold-out Claude 101 masterclass with GrowthX.

## Work with Pratik
- [Consulting](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/consulting/): AI-first growth marketing for seed-funded D2C and B2C startups
- [Advising](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/advising/): growth advisor and mentor to founders
- [Coaching](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/coaching/): career coaching for graduates and young professionals
- [Teaching](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/teaching/): growth marketing, go-to-market and AI for marketers
- [Speaking](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/speaking/): AI keynotes and hands-on AI workshops for marketers, founders and event organisers

## Playbooks
- [Ship a website with Claude in one hour, without coding](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/ship-a-website-with-claude-in-one-hour/): The exact steps from my sold-out Claude 101 masterclass: from a resume or product brief to a live website with a working lead form, using Claude, GitHub, Vercel and Supabase.
- [Set up an AI content agent for your brand](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/set-up-an-ai-content-agent-for-your-brand/): A practical setup for a small marketing team: one source piece in, a week of on-brand posts, emails and scripts out, with a person approving everything before it goes live.
- [Launch a Kickstarter campaign that funds in the first days](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/launch-a-kickstarter-campaign/): The playbook behind Infento's $848K Kickstarter, the most funded STEM project on the platform in 2018: build the list first, launch with momentum, keep backers close.
- [A 30 day AI plan for a marketing team](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/30-day-ai-plan-for-a-marketing-team/): Week by week: pick the work, train the team on real tasks, build three reliable workflows and report the results in numbers leadership cares about.
- [Run a weighted UX audit of a landing page](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/run-a-weighted-ux-audit-of-a-landing-page/): My UX audit template: score a page task by task across forms, layout, interaction, privacy and trust, weight each check, and fix the heavy ones first.
- [Build an ad specifications checklist for creative briefs](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/build-an-ad-specifications-checklist-for-creative-briefs/): Keep one page per platform and format with design, text and technical rules, so designers deliver ads that run first time on every channel.
- [Test your ecommerce checkout before a campaign](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/test-your-ecommerce-checkout-before-a-campaign/): The weekly checkout checklist I ran at Infento during campaigns: add to cart, contact, shipping and every payment method by country.
- [Plan a Christmas campaign for an ecommerce brand](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/plan-a-christmas-campaign-for-an-ecommerce-brand/): A phased plan from September to December: review past years, prepare assets, test in October, launch gift ads in November and boost in December.
- [Audit a Google search ads campaign](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/audit-a-google-search-ads-campaign/): The search ads audit I wrote for Sweek: settings, keywords, ads and reporting, with a checklist that removes what does not perform.
- [Do keyword research for search ads and SEO](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/do-keyword-research-for-search-ads-and-seo/): Start from the buyer persona, find root keywords, then split into a search ads track and an SEO track. The method I used for Sweek.
- [Fix the message order on a B2B landing page](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/fix-the-message-order-on-a-b2b-landing-page/): Answer six visitor questions in order: what can you do for me, why care, show me more, how can I be sure, what about objections, what next.
- [Build customer personas from your paying customers](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/build-customer-personas-from-your-paying-customers/): Use real customer data and feedback, not guesses: find your most active customers, describe them, and target more people like them.
- [Run Jobs to be Done customer interviews](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/interview-b2b-buyers-with-jobs-to-be-done-questions/): Five interview stages, from first thought to hiring criteria and anxieties, to learn why customers really choose you. The questions I used with SMPC.
- [Set up a customer referral programme](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/set-up-a-customer-referral-programme/): Reward both sides, match the reward to the product, and fix timing and friction first. What I learned setting up Bueno's referral programme.
- [Test message angles in a new country](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/test-message-angles-in-a-new-country/): Run several problem angles side by side before judging a market. In the UK, Bueno's hidden charges angle beat savings and service clearly.
- [Run weekly mini-projects as a growth team](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/run-weekly-mini-projects-as-a-growth-team/): Three to six small projects a week, each finished by Friday, next week planned by Saturday. The cadence I use to run growth at Bueno.
- [Plan the launch of a two-sided marketplace](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/plan-the-launch-of-a-two-sided-marketplace/): Problems, positioning, personas, supply and demand tactics and a milestone ladder: the launch plan I wrote for Nest.
- [Audit tracking before handing marketing to an agency](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/audit-tracking-before-handing-marketing-to-an-agency/): Check uptime, page speed, cookie consent, pixel firing and tag manager events before an agency starts spending. The audit I ran for Frecious.
- [Prioritise a growth backlog by effort and impact](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/prioritise-a-growth-backlog-by-effort-and-impact/): Score every task for effort and impact, sort, then turn the top of the list into a day by day plan. The method I use in growth plans for clients.
- [Layer your audiences on paid social](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/layer-your-audiences-on-paid-social/): Start with the narrowest, most likely buyers and widen in layers. One ad for one audience. How I targeted at Font Neuve, Le Patron and PCP.
- [Set up remarketing audiences based on intent](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/set-up-remarketing-audiences-based-on-intent/): Retarget the visitors who showed real intent: clicked for more info, scrolled most of the offer page, or spent the most time. Then remarket by product.
- [A 12-week growth plan for early-stage startups](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/12-week-growth-plan-for-early-stage-startups/): The 12-call growth programme I ran with seed-stage founders in the Newchip accelerator, turned into a weekly plan you can run yourself.
- [Run growth experiments with the GROWS loop](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/run-growth-experiments-with-the-grows-loop/): Gather, rank, outline, work, study: the experiment loop I teach seed-stage founders, with ICE and BRASS scoring and a five-week cycle.
- [Choose a One Metric That Matters for each funnel stage](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/choose-a-one-metric-that-matters-for-each-funnel-stage/): Pick one metric per funnel stage, from awareness to referral, so your team always knows which number to move this month.
- [Set a North Star Metric that reflects real customer value](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/set-a-north-star-metric/): Find your aha moment, turn it into one metric, refine it for value and test it against departments, revenue and your core promise.
- [Prioritise features and messaging with the Kano model](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/prioritise-features-with-the-kano-model/): Survey customers with paired Kano questions to sort basics, performance features and delighters, then build and promote the right ones.
- [Audit a Facebook and Instagram ads account in one session](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/audit-a-facebook-ads-account/): A three-level checklist for Meta ads: campaigns, ad sets and ads. Find wasted spend, missing tracking and untested assumptions.
- [Score and choose your first market with a six-factor scorecard](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/score-and-choose-your-first-market/): Rate each market 1 to 5 on time, money, excitement, commitment, the 90-day plan and five-year ROI to get a clear, unemotional winner.
- [Run problem-first customer discovery before you build](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/problem-first-customer-discovery/): A discovery process that keeps your demo out of the first 15 minutes, narrows a broad problem and finds problem-solution fit.
- [Test a career path before you commit to it](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/test-a-career-path-before-you-commit/): Turn each career option into a roadmap of cheap experiments, note what you like and dislike at every step, then choose with evidence.
- [Launch a D2C brand on Instagram in five weeks](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/launch-a-d2c-brand-on-instagram-in-5-weeks/): Problem first, brand second: a five-week Instagram launch for a new D2C brand, with an education channel and a brand channel.
- [The 5 prompts to build a portfolio site with Claude](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/the-5-prompts-to-build-a-portfolio-site-with-claude/): The five prompts from my Claude 101 masterclass: a first draft from your resume, a redesign from a reference site, two game versions and one page with a form.
- [Connect a website form to Supabase safely](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/connect-a-website-form-to-supabase-safely/): Capture leads from a static site in Supabase, with Row Level Security so visitors can submit but never read anyone's data. From my Claude 101 session.
- [Run a value proposition workshop for founders](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/run-a-value-proposition-workshop-for-founders/): A 90 minute workshop format: the lean feedback loop, Jobs to be Done, the value proposition canvas and a 30 minute team exercise on each startup's own product.
- [Run an idea validation workshop for early founders](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/run-an-idea-validation-workshop/): Help founders choose between ideas: six stages of a startup, a prioritisation sheet, validation questions, a stakeholder map and a 20 minute ranking exercise.
- [Host a build night for your community](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/host-a-build-night-for-your-community/): Run an evening where 20 builders ship a half finished project: the cap, the venue, the hosts and the four hour flow, based on Builders Night Out in Pune.
- [Build an automated content publishing system for your team](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/build-an-automated-content-publishing-system-for-your-team/): The content system I teach: an agent drafts, a person reviews by email, a tool sends, and the team posts daily without the founder writing every post.
- [Teach a marketing module with your own launch as the case](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/teach-a-marketing-module-with-your-own-launch-case/): How I built the FutureMBA marketing and sales module around the Infento Kickstarter: one real case, reusable templates and practice on your own product.
- [Run a technical SEO audit with a priority checklist](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/run-a-technical-seo-audit-with-a-priority-checklist/): My SEO step by step template: check findability, architecture, URLs, on page basics, link equity and Search Console, then fix high priority items first.
- [Run a website growth audit across nine categories](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/run-a-website-growth-audit-across-nine-categories/): Score a site on UX, conversion, SEO, performance, platform health, accessibility, copy, legal and analytics, then fix high impact gaps first.
- [Brief UGC creators for an ad campaign](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/brief-ugc-creators-for-an-ad-campaign/): The UGC brief I wrote for Bueno: brand, audience, dos and donts, hooks, ad structures, tech specs, a pre-send checklist and a staged approval flow.
- [Build an ad angle library for a D2C brand](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/build-an-ad-angle-library-for-a-d2c-brand/): Keep one page per ad angle with the script, examples and assets, so each new campaign starts from tested ideas. Based on VU's angle library.
- [Turn 25 customer problems into ads that resonate](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/turn-25-customer-problems-into-ads/): Find 25 problems, rank them by pain, match your solution, write 10 hooks and use 10 ad templates. The method I use for ads that fit a market.
- [Script a premium product video ad in seven beats](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/script-a-premium-product-video-ad-in-seven-beats/): Problem, twist, half solution, social proof, full solution, objections, reassurance, then the call to action. The structure I used for VU's goggle ads.
- [Run a Black Friday early access email campaign](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/run-a-black-friday-early-access-email-campaign/): Send a heads-up email the day before, give list members access before the public offer with a real limit, and spend most words on why the product is worth it.
- [Launch a weekly newsletter for a niche audience](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/launch-a-weekly-niche-newsletter/): A fixed four section template, an FAQ bank from real customer questions, a one click rating and a referral ask. Based on Bueno's newsletter.
- [Grow an X account to 1,000 followers with a daily system](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/grow-an-x-account-to-1000-followers-with-a-daily-system/): Set goals and a time budget, then run a fixed daily and weekly routine of posts, replies and messages with milestones to 1,000 followers.
- [Audit a login and registration flow](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/playbooks/audit-a-login-and-registration-flow/): Check login, registration, password and error handling with weighted checks, so returning and new users get in without friction.

## Case studies
- [Infento: building a direct to consumer engine from zero](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/work/infento/): How I built Infento's online marketing from scratch, from funnel and tracking to paid channels and awards, taking DTC sales from zero to 2M euro ARR.
- [Infento on Kickstarter: the most funded STEM project of 2018](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/work/infento-kickstarter/): How I led Infento's second generation launch on Kickstarter: a lead list built before launch, a phased campaign and press outreach. $848K raised.
- [VU: making a Swiss goggle brand the choice of pro skiers](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/work/vu/): How I rebuilt VU's webshop and marketing as Head of Marketing: Olympian proof, customer words in ads, Hotjar-led fixes. 275K+ euro revenue, 4.4x peak season.
- [Bueno: building fintech marketing alone across 28 countries](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/work/bueno/): How I built Bueno's online marketing single-handedly across 28 countries for foreign property owners in Spain, reaching a 24x LTV to CAC ratio.
- [Sweek: cutting acquisition cost by more than half for a story app](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/work/sweek/): How I advised Sweek's CEO in 2017: an influencer launch, a trained team with written channel rules, and paid campaigns rebuilt to cut acquisition cost 50%+.
- [Font Neuve: from no bookings to fully booked during COVID](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/work/font-neuve/): How I built a French holiday resort's first online presence in weeks in 2020, found a new home market with layered targeting and filled the season.
- [Le Patron: a full funnel for a cycling menswear brand](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/work/le-patron/): How I gave a Dutch cycling-inspired menswear brand a full funnel: hyper-specific targeting, shopping and remarketing, and yearly Christmas campaigns.
- [PCP: validating a startup idea in 12 weeks, and knowing when to stop](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/work/pcp-personal-city-plan/): How I built an MVP funnel for Personal City Plan in a week, ran tightly targeted ads and gave founders and investors a clear answer on viability.
- [SMPC: a conversion audit and lean plan for a niche B2B service](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/work/smpc/): How I audited a Swiss medical device compliance firm's website, rewrote the order of its message, and planned lean marketing for a niche audience.
- [Frecious: a tracking and site audit before the agency handover](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/work/frecious/): How I checked a Dutch organic drinks brand's site speed, cookie consent, pixel and tag setup before it handed marketing to an agency.
- [Nest: a launch plan for a wellbeing platform for professionals](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/work/nest/): How I wrote the launch plan for Nest, a two-sided wellbeing platform for doctors and other high-pressure professionals: personas, push and pull, milestones.
- [Growack: marketing for a B2B growth agency and HubSpot partner](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/work/growack/): My work as Head of Marketing at Growack, a B2B growth agency and HubSpot partner in Amsterdam: HubSpot setup, goals, budget and an execution plan.
- [Bayer: running a 250K euro global senior executive event](https://www.pratikrenuse.com/work/bayer-executive-event/): In 2017 I ran a 250K euro global senior executive event for Bayer in Germany, working directly with senior leaders across the company.
